reviewer.coverage: 12 stationary cockpit stations, final Sphere/kerb rechecks, 17 actual live-lap sector frames plus live recording journal, and targeted shadow rechecks
reviewer.result: No blocking geometry, protection, driving-path or visual findings remain in reviewed evidence.

checks.saved_native_asset_verification: 152 reopened assets match triangle counts and source hashes

limits: Road width is estimated at 12–16 m, not a white-line survey.
2022 bare-earth terrain predates the racing deck; 24 m filtering reconstructs short ground breaks.
City facades, temporary event furniture and venue display are original approximations.
Physical controller hardware has not been tested.

live_packaged_lap.source: Full live packaged Unreal simulation, Las Vegas-only audit control at 0.60 pace; keyboard accel/steer/brake and pause/resume also exercised
live_packaged_lap.recording_note: Capped 30 fps with JPEG/readback overhead; this recording is not the uncapped performance measurement.

closed_findings.problem: Generic narrow-corridor ribbon, missing major buildings and venue identity
closed_findings.resolution: Native streamed scenery, wider OSM footprint extract, venue landmarks, pit frontage, crowds and protection.

closed_findings.problem: Rendered road and wheel contact were not tied to one source; terrain reader began four bytes early
closed_findings.resolution: Render the exact contact triangles, parse the 36-byte header, verify saved meshes in a fresh editor and compare all road vertices.

closed_findings.problem: Short pre-construction terrain breaks and wrong start location
closed_findings.resolution: Recorded 24m profile filter; start/finish moved to pit straight at station 1815m.

closed_findings.problem: Mirrored/buried signage, stretched fence UVs, flat crowd atlas and oversized grid marks
closed_findings.resolution: Face/UV/offset corrections, seated atlas cells, discrete grid and kerb markings.
Original dense jellyfish LED artwork and coherent spherical UVs; Luna High closed the finding.

closed_findings.problem: Opaque fictional boards cast broad shadows across bends
closed_findings.resolution: Open lighting trusses replace non-start boards; ground/paint shadow sections corrected; Luna High closed the 650m finding.

observations.status: Not a demonstrated blocker after source/caster review
observations.evidence: Unchanged sun rays intersect the registered 83m OSM tower way 115766962 above the road around stations 5950-6000. Building identity/source fidelity has not been independently established.

performance.hardware: Intel Core i7-1255U / Iris Xe, Linux Vulkan SM5, Unreal 5.8.3 Development
performance.conditions: 1600x900, 100% render scale, shared default AA/quality/cockpit; VSync and t.MaxFPS disabled; no frame recording
performance.input: Existing FFDrive diagnostic control, starting at 1795m on Las Vegas and 0m on accepted tracks; 60s runs, 1400-frame CSV boot capture
performance.sampling: CSV frames 500 through 1399, after initial loading; these selected route windows do not establish universal full-lap or physical-controller performance

asset_revision_note: Full live lap/session recording precedes only the final cosmetic shadow-section/truss correction. Same-view 650m and 5900m captures recheck that correction; contact surfaces and gameplay code are identical.
